system.roleplaying: You ignore damage from unpowered close-combat weapons and attacks, such as clubs and non-powered fists, or basic ranged attacks, such as slings and arrows.
system.majorTwist: Who gets hurt other than you as a result of you not being able to take damage?

greenAbility.name: Principle of the Indestructible
greenAbility.gameText: A Overcome in a situation where you charge headlong into danger and use your Max die. You and each of your allies gain a hero point.
